sentences.text: My name's Sally.
When I was fourteen years old, my family and I lived in an old house near the hills in New Zealand.
sentences.translation: عندما كان عمري أربعة عشر عاماً، عشت أنا وعائلتي في منزل قديم بالقرب من التلال في نيوزيلندا.

sentences.text: There was me, Mum, Dad, my brother Richard, and my Gran.
sentences.translation: كان هناك أنا، وأمي، وأبي، وأخي ريتشارد، وجدتي.

sentences.text: My Gran was old - nearly eighty-two years old - and sometimes she told us strange stories.
sentences.translation: كانت جدتي عجوزاً - تقرب من الثانية والثمانين - وأحياناً كانت تحكي لنا قصصاً غريبة.

sentences.text: She loved talking about our grandfather, George.
sentences.translation: كانت تحب التحدث عن جدنا، جورج.

sentences.text: He died before I was born.
'He's always here with us,' she told me.
'I sometimes hear him at night.'
He walks about in the garden.'
Of course, I didn't believe her stories.
'How do you know?' I asked her.
'Perhaps it's an animal.'
'Because I can see his footprints,' Gran told me.
'George had very big feet.'
We always laughed about his big feet.'
sentences.translation: كنا دائماً نضحك على قدميه الكبيرتين.'

sentences.text: But we never saw the footprints.
'She's old and she can't see very well,' we all thought.
sentences.translation: فكرنا جميعاً: 'إنها عجوز ولا تستطيع الرؤية جيداً'.

sentences.text: When winter came, there was snow everywhere, and it was very cold.
sentences.translation: عندما جاء الشتاء، كان الثلج في كل مكان، وكان الجو بارداً جداً.

sentences.text: One morning I went to the kitchen to make breakfast.
sentences.translation: في إحدى الصباحات ذهبت إلى المطبخ لإعداد الإفطار.

sentences.text: But when I opened the kitchen door and walked into the room, I screamed.
sentences.translation: لكن عندما فتحت باب المطبخ ودخلت الغرفة، صرخت.

sentences.text: There were things all over the floor, and the kitchen window and the fridge door were open.
sentences.translation: كانت هناك أشياء في كل مكان على الأرض، وكانت نافذة المطبخ وباب الثلاجة مفتوحين.

sentences.text: Mum came into the kitchen after me.
'Oh, dear! What's this?' she said.
She called Dad.
'Look at all this! Who did it?'
sentences.translation: 'انظر إلى كل هذا! من فعل هذا؟'

sentences.text: 'Perhaps it was the children,' Dad said, and he looked at me.
sentences.translation: قال أبي: 'ربما كان الأطفال'، ونظر إليّ.

sentences.text: 'Don't look at me, Dad. I was in bed!' I said.
sentences.translation: قلت: 'لا تنظر إليّ يا أبي. كنت في السرير!'

sentences.text: Just then, Gran walked into the kitchen.
sentences.translation: في تلك اللحظة، دخلت جدتي إلى المطبخ.

sentences.text: 'Good morning, everybody. I - Oh! What's all this?'
sentences.translation: 'صباح الخير للجميع. أنا - أوه! ما كل هذا؟'

sentences.text: Everybody helped to put away the kitchen things.
sentences.translation: ساعد الجميع في ترتيب أدوات المطبخ.

sentences.text: When we finished, Dad looked in the fridge for something to eat.
sentences.translation: عندما انتهينا، بحث أبي في الثلاجة عن شيء ليأكله.

sentences.text: 'Look at this!' he said.
Everything in the fridge was suddenly old and bad.
sentences.translation: كل شيء في الثلاجة أصبح فجأة قديماً وفاسداً.

sentences.text: The milk was yellow and the bread was green.
'I don't believe it!' said Mum.
'It was OK yesterday. What is happening?'
That night, we were all very tired and everybody went to bed early.
sentences.translation: في تلك الليلة، كنا جميعاً متعبين جداً وذهب الجميع إلى السرير مبكراً.

sentences.text: It was not a good night.
At three o'clock in the morning, my brother Richard ran into my room.
sentences.translation: في الساعة الثالثة صباحاً، ركض أخي ريتشارد إلى غرفتي.

sentences.text: 'Come quickly!' he cried. 'There's somebody in my room!'
sentences.translation: صرخ: 'تعالي بسرعة! هناك شخص ما في غرفتي!'

sentences.text: I ran after him, and Mum and Dad followed.
Richard's room looked bad.
His computer was on the floor and his books were everywhere.
sentences.translation: كان حاسوبه على الأرض وكتبه في كل مكان.

sentences.text: 'I heard somebody in my room, Dad,' said Richard.
sentences.translation: قال ريتشارد: 'سمعت شخصاً ما في غرفتي يا أبي'.

sentences.text: 'They took all the things off my table and put them on the floor!'
sentences.translation: 'أخذوا كل الأشياء من على طاولتي ووضعوها على الأرض!'

sentences.text: 'I'm going to phone the police,' said Dad.
'Perhaps there are some bad people in the hills near our house.'
sentences.translation: 'ربما هناك بعض الأشخاص السيئين في التلال القريبة من منزلنا'.

sentences.text: But, when the police came, they didn't know about any bad people in the hills.
sentences.translation: لكن عندما جاءت الشرطة، لم تكن تعرف عن أي أشخاص سيئين في التلال.

sentences.text: Nothing strange happened for two days.
sentences.translation: لم يحدث شيء غريب لمدة يومين.

sentences.text: But on the third day, the radio began to make unusual noises.
sentences.translation: لكن في اليوم الثالث، بدأ الراديو يصدر أصواتاً غير عادية.

sentences.text: Then the TV broke down.
And when we all sat down for dinner, the lights suddenly went out.
sentences.translation: وعندما جلسنا جميعاً لتناول العشاء، انطفأت الأضواء فجأة.

sentences.text: Mum screamed, but Dad got angry.
'What is going on?' he asked.
'Perhaps it's George,' said Gran.
'Oh, Gran,' said Dad. 'We don't believe in ghosts.'
sentences.translation: قال أبي: 'أوه، جدتي. نحن لا نؤمن بالأشباح'.

sentences.text: Later that night, I heard some very strange noises.
sentences.translation: في وقت لاحق من تلك الليلة، سمعت بعض الأصوات الغريبة جداً.

sentences.text: They came from the living room.
'Somebody's moving the table and chairs,' I thought.
Quickly, I went into Richard's room.
'Listen,' I said. 'Someone's downstairs.'
sentences.translation: قلت: 'اسمع. هناك شخص في الطابق السفلي'.

sentences.text: We ran down to the living room and opened the door.
sentences.translation: ركضنا إلى غرفة الجلوس وفتحنا الباب.

sentences.text: Nobody was there.
But the chairs were all up on the table, the pictures, the radio and the TV were all on the floor, and the door to the garden was open.
sentences.translation: لكن الكراسي كانت كلها على الطاولة، والصور والراديو والتلفزيون كانت كلها على الأرض، وكان باب الحديقة مفتوحاً.

sentences.text: Mum, Dad and Gran soon came downstairs, too.
sentences.translation: سرعان ما نزلت أمي وأبي وجدتي أيضاً.

sentences.text: 'Someone's in the garden,' said Dad.
'I'm going after him.'
'Be careful!' called Mum.
The lights went out again, and there were more strange noises.
sentences.translation: انطفأت الأضواء مرة أخرى، وكانت هناك المزيد من الأصوات الغريبة.

sentences.text: We were all very scared by now.
'Follow Dad!' Mum screamed.
So we all ran out into the garden.
Just then, the ground began to move under our feet.
sentences.translation: في تلك اللحظة، بدأت الأرض تتحرك تحت أقدامنا.

sentences.text: Then there was a very big noise.
sentences.translation: ثم كان هناك صوت كبير جداً.

sentences.text: 'It's an earthquake!' screamed Dad.
The ground moved again and again.
We stopped running and looked back at our house.
sentences.translation: توقفنا عن الجري ونظرنا إلى منزلنا.

sentences.text: It suddenly fell to the ground in front of our eyes.
sentences.translation: سقط فجأة على الأرض أمام أعيننا.

sentences.text: After the earthquake finished, we all stood quietly for some minutes.
sentences.translation: بعد انتهاء الزلزال، وقفنا جميعاً بهدوء لبعض الدقائق.

sentences.text: Then Gran spoke.
'Well, we lost our house, but we're all alive!' she said quietly.
sentences.translation: قالت بهدوء: 'حسناً، لقد فقدنا منزلنا، لكننا جميعاً أحياء!'

sentences.text: 'It was George. He helped us.'
'He took us out of the house.'
Look, there are his footprints in the snow.'
We all looked down at the ground.
It was dark, but we could see some footprints in the snow.
sentences.translation: كان الجو مظلماً، لكننا استطعنا رؤية بعض الآثار في الثلج.

sentences.text: They were the footprints of very big feet.
'Thank you, Grandad,' I said quietly.
'Thank you for helping us.'
- THE END -
